operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Katz Says Israel 'Organised and Prepared' to Remove Gaza Population Once Trump Approves — Two Killed in Jabalia Strike
heroSubtitle: On Day 1057 (Sep 2, 2026), Defense Minister Israel Katz said Israel remains ready to facilitate Palestinian emigration from Gaza 'by any means' once Trump approves the plan, calling it merely 'frozen' rather than cancelled and claiming 80% of Gazans want to leave; Netanyahu separately visited an IDF post in Gaza and said Israel will not withdraw from territory it controls. Israeli forces killed two Palestinians in Jabalia town and refugee camp — gunfire toward displacement tents and a drone strike on a civilian gathering — while Gaza's Health Ministry reported 8 killed and 31 wounded strip-wide in the preceding 24 hours, pushing the cumulative toll to 73,470+ and the ceasefire-period toll to 1,334 killed, 4,429 wounded. On Day 1056 (Sep 1), Shin Bet commandos raided the Al Katiba area of western Gaza City, capturing wounded Hamas internal security chief Muein al-Arabid; covering IAF strikes killed at least 3, including al-Arabid's wife, and wounded 8, while separate strikes elsewhere in Gaza killed at least 4 more including children. On Day 1055 (Aug 31), Israeli drone strikes killed five Palestinians in Gaza City: two when a strike hit the entrance of a residential building near the municipal public park, in an area packed with displaced families, and three when a separate strike destroyed a civilian vehicle in the Tal al-Hawa neighborhood. The IDF said both strikes targeted Hamas Ezzedine al-Qassam Brigades operatives without providing evidence. Disarmament talks remain at an impasse.

Day 1056 (Sep 1): Shin Bet raid in Al Katiba, Gaza City captures Hamas internal security chief Muein al-Arabid; covering IAF strikes kill 3, wound 8; separate strikes kill 4+ more including children. Day 1055 (Aug 31): Israeli drone strikes kill 5 in Gaza City — 2 near the municipal park (residential building entrance) and 3 in a Tal al-Hawa vehicle strike; IDF says both hit Qassam Brigades operatives; UN's Dujarric voices concern over continued airstrikes' civilian impact. Day 1054 (Aug 30): IDF kills Nukhba cmdr Mazloum and sniper Deiri in northern Gaza; separate Deir al-Balah strike kills operative Nasir and 3-yr-old Tayyem Hamdan. Day 1053 (Aug 29): Strikes kill 6+ across Gaza City, Khan Younis, al-Musaddar, Jabalia incl. Nukhba cmdr Abu al-Eish and 2 more Nukhba members; Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital supply tent struck a 2nd time in a month, wounding 3. Day 1052 (Aug 28): Strikes kill 5 — 3 from Abdeen family north of Khan Younis, 2 more in Sabra/Mashahra, Gaza City; IDF claims (no evidence) killing operative Bitawi and 2 Hamas/PIJ commanders. Day 1046 (Aug 22): Drone strike kills Hamas Deir al-Balah Battalion cmdr Sharif al-Hasanat; Hamas says not obligated to implement Trump deal without Israeli acceptance. Day 1045 (Aug 21): Poland summons Israeli ambassador over dropped WCK probe; IDF shoots Palestinian crossing Yellow Line in southern Gaza. Day 1044 (Aug 20): Mass funeral in Gaza City for 50 Palestinians (19 children) recovered from Dec 2023 strike rubble; Australia anger over dropped WCK case. Day 965 (Jun 2): IDF drones strike Jabalia, Al-Zawayda, Al-Bureij; 2 killed, 40 wounded in 24-hr period; new Mossad chief Gofman takes over; AP analysis confirms ceasefire hollow — Israel controls 60% of Gaza, Phase 2 paralyzed. Day 964 (Jun 1): IDF strikes continue; Hamas warns dangerous escalation. Day 963 (May 31): Apache strike Gaza seaport cafe — 2 killed, 12 wounded. Day 962 (May 30): Israeli strike kills Palestinian doctor, wounds 3. Day 961 (May 29): Netanyahu 70% Gaza directive. Day 960 (May 28): IDF strikes Gaza City residential building — 10 killed including 4 children. UNRWA staff killed: 397.
